name: mimir
description: A chat panel for the MIMIR agent: plan, edit, run and verify code with the model server you already run (vLLM, Ray Serve, Ollama or Claude).

mimir.backend.description: LLM backend: vllm (default, OpenAI-compatible API), ray (a Ray Serve LLM router — the same API, with the cluster placing and scaling the vLLM engines behind it), ollama, or anthropic (hosted Claude API)

mimir.vllmBaseUrl.description: Default address of your running vLLM server, e.g. http://10.0.0.4:8000. Editable in the connect panel — this is only the value it starts with.

mimir.rayBaseUrl.description: Default address of your running Ray Serve LLM router, including the app's route prefix if it has one, e.g. http://10.0.0.4:8000. Editable in the connect panel — this is only the value it starts with.

mimir.ollamaUrl.description: Default address of your running Ollama server, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:11434. Editable in the connect panel — this is only the value it starts with.

mimir.anthropicAvailableModels.description: Claude model IDs shown in the model selector when backend is Anthropic. Edit in settings.json to add or reorder models.

mimir.vllmVerifySsl.description: Verify the TLS certificate of the vLLM or Ray Serve endpoint (one switch for both). Disable (uncheck) for internal HTTPS routes served behind a private/corporate CA that isn't in the system trust store (avoids CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED). Sets VLLM_VERIFY_SSL=0 for the server.

mimir.wsUrl.description: Leave empty: each VS Code window starts its own MIMIR server on a free port, so several windows run side by side. Set a URL only to attach to a server you started yourself (here or on another host) — the extension then starts none.

mimir.maxModelLen.description: Context window (max_model_len) of the served model, in tokens. Leave at 0 to detect it from the endpoint's /v1/models. Set it when that endpoint does not publish max_model_len — an OpenAI-compatible router in front of vLLM usually does not — otherwise MIMIR falls back to a static 200000-token assumption, and its context bar, trimming and compaction all size themselves to that instead of your model. A window published by the endpoint always wins over this setting. Sets MIMIR_VLLM_MAX_MODEL_LEN and MIMIR_RAY_MAX_MODEL_LEN for the server.

mimir.vllmTokenize.description: Count tokens exactly with the endpoint's /tokenize (vLLM or Ray Serve). Uncheck when the endpoint is a router that does not serve it, or answers it slowly: token counts then use an estimate calibrated against what the server reports for each prompt, and no request is spent on /tokenize. Sets MIMIR_VLLM_TOKENIZE=0 for the server.

mimir.ollama.numCtx.markdownDescription: Ollama context window (`num_ctx`), in tokens. Leave at 0 to use the model's trained context length. Sets `MIMIR_OLLAMA_NUM_CTX` for the server.

enumDescriptions: Send no effort parameter, for an older model that predates it
mimir.anthropic.effort.markdownDescription: Reasoning and output effort of Claude models (Anthropic backend). Sets `MIMIR_ANTHROPIC_EFFORT` for the server.

mimir.anthropic.thinking.markdownDescription: Let Claude models think adaptively (Anthropic backend). Uncheck for an older model that rejects adaptive thinking. Sets `MIMIR_ANTHROPIC_THINKING=off` for the server.

mimir.anthropic.maxTokens.markdownDescription: Maximum output tokens per Claude reply. Leave at 0 for 16000. Sets `MIMIR_ANTHROPIC_MAX_TOKENS` for the server.

mimir.anthropic.maxInputTokens.markdownDescription: Context window of the Claude model, in tokens. Leave at 0 to ask the API, falling back to the model's known window. Sets `MIMIR_ANTHROPIC_MAX_INPUT_TOKENS` for the server.

mimir.embeddings.model.markdownDescription: Embedding model for semantic memory search and tool ranking. **Required for vLLM and Ray Serve** (the served model name, e.g. `BAAI/bge-m3`); empty there disables the semantic path and MIMIR falls back to lexical search. Empty on Ollama means `nomic-embed-text`. Sets `MIMIR_EMBED_MODEL` for the server.

mimir.embeddings.baseUrl.markdownDescription: Serve embeddings from another endpoint than the chat model (vLLM and Ray Serve only). Empty uses the active backend's address. Sets `MIMIR_EMBED_BASE_URL` for the server.

mimir.embeddings.timeout.markdownDescription: HTTP timeout of an embeddings call, in seconds. Sets `MIMIR_EMBED_TIMEOUT` for the server.

mimir.sessions.maxLive.markdownDescription: How many conversations may hold an agent at once. Each agent runs some nineteen MCP servers, so lower it on a shared login node. Past the cap a turn waits for a slot; conversations you only open or read cost nothing. Sets `MIMIR_MAX_LIVE_SESSIONS` for the server.

mimir.sessions.idleTimeout.markdownDescription: Seconds a conversation's agent may sit unused before it is released, servers included (minimum 30). Never one that is busy, waiting on a question, watching a background job, or on screen. Sets `MIMIR_SESSION_IDLE_TTL` for the server.

mimir.sessions.initTimeout.markdownDescription: Seconds to wait for a conversation's agent to come up — the LLM backend first, then its servers. A cold vLLM (model load plus `torch.compile`) can take over three minutes. Sets `MIMIR_INIT_TIMEOUT` for the server.

mimir.sessions.backendWaitTimeout.markdownDescription: Seconds to wait for a self-hosted LLM endpoint to answer its health check before giving up. Sets `MIMIR_BACKEND_TIMEOUT` for the server.

mimir.sessions.backendPollInterval.markdownDescription: Seconds between two health checks while waiting for the LLM endpoint. Sets `MIMIR_BACKEND_POLL_INTERVAL` for the server.

mimir.subagents.maxConcurrent.markdownDescription: How many sub-agents one conversation may run at once. Sets `MIMIR_SUBAGENT_MAX_CONCURRENT` for the server.

mimir.subagents.copiesDir.markdownDescription: Directory holding the copies of the repository that working sub-agents build and run in, one per sub-agent. Pick one the compute nodes see, so a sub-agent's Slurm jobs can read their copy. Empty uses `$SCRATCH`, else the local temp directory. Sets `MIMIR_SUBAGENT_COPIES_DIR` for the server.

mimir.server.idleTimeout.markdownDescription: Seconds a detached server must have nothing to do — no turn in flight, no run to watch — before it stops on its own (minimum 60). Sets `MIMIR_SERVER_IDLE_TTL` for the server.

mimir.server.detachGrace.markdownDescription: Seconds the chat panel may be disconnected before its window counts as gone. A reload stays within it. Sets `MIMIR_DETACH_GRACE` for the server.

mimir.customization.systemPromptFile.markdownDescription: A `.md` file replacing the doctrine half of the agent's general context. Empty uses `.mimir/system_prompt.md` when it exists. A relative path is taken from the workspace root. Sets `MIMIR_SYSTEM_PROMPT_FILE` for the server.

mimir.customization.skillsDir.markdownDescription: Directory of your skills. Empty uses `.mimir/skills`. Sets `MIMIR_SKILLS_DIR` for the server.

mimir.customization.pluginsDir.markdownDescription: Directory of your plugins. Empty uses `.mimir/plugins`. Sets `MIMIR_PLUGINS_DIR` for the server.

mimir.customization.serversDir.markdownDescription: Directory of your MCP servers. Empty uses `.mimir/servers`. Sets `MIMIR_SERVERS_DIR` for the server.

mimir.workspace.extraReadRoots.markdownDescription: Directories outside the workspace that the agent may read without asking. Sets `MIMIR_EXTRA_FILE_ROOTS` for the server.

mimir.workspace.scratchDir.markdownDescription: The agent's scratchpad, where it writes throwaway scripts and test files without asking. Empty uses `$SCRATCH/mimir-<uid>-<workspace>`, else the same under the local temp directory. On a cluster, pick a directory the compute nodes see, so a job can run what the agent wrote there. Give it a directory of its own, such as `$SCRATCH/mimir-scratch`: everything under it is writable without approval. Sets `MIMIR_SCRATCH_DIR` for the server.

mimir.hpc.moduleIndexBudget.markdownDescription: Seconds the background indexing of environment modules (Lmod `spider`, then `whatis`) may take. It changes how much of a large module tree gets descriptions, never how long a search takes to answer. Sets `MIMIR_MODULE_INDEX_BUDGET` for the server.

mimir.hpc.slurmStaleAfter.markdownDescription: Seconds after which a Slurm submission nobody watches no longer counts as running (minimum 3600). A watched job settles on its own. Sets `MIMIR_SLURM_STALE_AFTER` for the server.

mimir.pythonPath.description: Python executable used to start the WS server. Leave empty: install.sh records the venv interpreter in ~/.mimir/python and the extension picks it up (the MIMIR_PYTHON environment variable also works). Set this only to override both.

mimir.releaseHome.description: Shared site release root for enterprise deployments. When set, the extension takes its Python backend and its own updates from <releaseHome>/current. Leave empty to follow the path a deployment ships in the extension's own site.json. To disable the shared-release mode, point this at a path that has no current release.

mimir.notifications.enabled.description: Show a VS Code notification when a task finishes or MIMIR needs your answer while the chat panel is hidden or out of focus.

mimir.notifications.duration.description: Seconds a MIMIR notification stays on screen once the window has focus. It then moves to the notification centre (the bell), buttons included. 0 leaves it to VS Code, which keeps errors and notifications with buttons until they are closed.

mimir.server.env.markdownDescription: Extra environment variables for the server, for anything without a setting of its own, e.g. `{"MIMIR_PROXY_BENCH_DIR": "/scratch/bench"}`. They go last and win over the settings above. User settings only: a workspace cannot set them.
